overview: 2026年，Magma Group Berhad 完成了以 RM63.00 million 出售 Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd 全部20%股权的交易，并通过持股80%的子公司 Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd 以 RM2.8 million 收购 Magma Christine Sdn Bhd 全部股权，同时于3月签署的 Heads of Agreement 已于11月双方同意终止。
overview_en: In 2026, Magma Group Berhad completed the disposal of its entire 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd for RM63.00 million and, through its 80%-owned subsidiary Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd, acquired the entire equity interest in Magma Christine Sdn Bhd for RM2.8 million, while a Heads of Agreement signed in March was mutually terminated in November.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成出售 Heritage Lane 20%股权，并终止一项3月签署的 Heads of Agreement。
segments.note_en: Completed the disposal of 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane and terminated a Heads of Agreement signed in March.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 双方决定不继续进行3月5日签署的 Heads of Agreement，并同意相互终止。
actions.text_en: The parties decided not to proceed with the Heads of Agreement dated 5 March and agreed to mutually terminate it.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 出售 Heritage Lane 20%股权于9月1日完成，余额代价已全部支付。
actions.text_en: The disposal of the 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane was completed on 1 September, with the balance disposal consideration fully paid.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 出售 Heritage Lane 20%股权的条件于6月11日满足，买卖协议成为无条件。
actions.text_en: The condition precedent for the disposal of the 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane was fulfilled on 11 June, and the share sale agreement became unconditional.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 3月5日与卖方签署 Heads of Agreement。
actions.text_en: Entered into a Heads of Agreement with the vendors on 5 March.

actions.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DISPOSAL OF THE ENTIRE 20% EQUITY INTEREST IN HERITAGE LANE SDN BHD BY ASTAKA MEKAR SDN
actions.text_en: Proposed disposal of the entire 20% equity interest in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd to Harum Aspirasi Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM63.00 million.

segments.name: 食品业务 / Food
segments.note: 通过80%持股的 Magma Food Ventures 收购 Magma Christine 全部股权，金额 RM2.8 million。
segments.note_en: Acquiring the entire equity interest in Magma Christine for RM2.8 million through 80%-owned Magma Food Ventures.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 持股80%的 Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd 以 RM2,800,000 现金收购 Magma Christine Sdn Bhd 全部股权。
actions.text_en: 80%-owned Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd is acquiring the entire equity interest in Magma Christine Sdn Bhd for a cash consideration of RM2,800,000.

model_changes.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE PROPOSED DISPOSAL OF THE ENTIRE 20% EQUITY INTEREST IN HERITAGE LANE SDN BHD BY ASTAKA MEKAR SDN
model_changes.text: 退出 Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd 的20%股权投资。
model_changes.text_en: Exit from the 20% equity investment in Heritage Lane Sdn Bhd.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 通过新设80%持股的 Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd 收购 Magma Christine Sdn Bhd，扩展食品业务。
model_changes.text_en: Expansion into food business through the acquisition of Magma Christine Sdn Bhd by newly incorporated 80%-owned Magma Food Ventures Sdn Bhd.
